correctness.rationale: The explicitly defined twelve-vertex graph is degree five with thirty edges and twenty triangles; component membership is independently checked by BFS, disjoint-set union and avoidance of connected (r+1)-subsets on all 4,096 vertex masks. For r=3,4,5,6 the four explicit complete Morse matchings leave only one zero-cell plus 10 degree-three, 70 degree-three, 350 degree-four or 450 degree-five critical cells. Directed Hasse acyclicity is verified on 2,592/4,512/7,404/12,360 incidences, so the Morse-CW theorem gives integral sphere wedges, not only rational/mod-two homology. Direct mod-two boundary ranks agree. Verified deletion connectivity of all <=4 vertex sets gives the exact high-r skeleton and contractible cases.

value.rationale: These four exact integral homotopy types classify all challenging intermediate stages of the natural connected-component-size filtration on the canonical icosahedron graph, including the abrupt 3/3/4/5 degree and 10/70/350/450 multiplicity pattern. They go strictly beyond previously computed size-two/induced-forest results and are not arbitrary finite slices or just numerical Betti tables. The high-connectivity skeleton stages provide a complete exact tail, transparently identified as elementary rather than standalone novelty.
